generation_history.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: enhanced pixel/voxel equipment reference sheet, page 1 of 2.
Input image 1 is the ORIGINAL Gear/magic.dmi contact sheet and is authoritative for the item designs, occupied cells and directional silhouettes. Input image 2 (Gear/spiderfang.dmi) is only the STYLE reference: polished crisp pixel/voxel edges, dark outlines, dimensional stepped highlights, compact bright accents on a plain charcoal background.

Redraw and enhance ONLY the first SEVEN state rows from input image 1, keeping their exact order and all FOUR directional views per row. Output a complete clean page with exactly 7 rows and 4 evenly spaced artwork columns. Keep generous label margin on the left. No other rows, no missing or duplicate rows. Compact title at the top: "Gear/magic.dmi — Page 1 of 2". Column headings: "S", "N", "E", "W", in that exact left-to-right order.
Exact left-side row labels, one per row:
magic.crystal staff
magic.orb staff
magic.skull staff
magic.flame staff
magic.nature staff
magic.dragon staff
magic.spider staff

Preserve each original cell's orientation, distinct silhouette, length and item identity. Every one of these 28 cells is occupied. Staff shafts are slender dark brown wood with warm golden brown stepped highlights. Their heads keep the source colors and designs: cyan faceted crystal; violet orb; pale green skull-like magical head; small orange fire head; green nature sprout/orb; brown-gold dragon-shaped head; dark charcoal spider-shaped head with restrained green accents. Enhance the existing small shapes without inventing large new decorations.
Lighting: consistent top-left highlights, rich dark recesses and restrained vibrant emissive pixels. Pixel-art edges must remain clean, no airbrush blur, no soft glow halos, no photographic textures. Match the reference's restrained polished game-asset presentation.

Constraints: exact seven listed rows, four columns and 28 staff drawings. Preserve partial or occluded directional forms exactly where present. Do not fill in obscured parts. No characters, no hands, no equipment wearers, no extra items, no runes or text on items, no giant detailed skulls or dragons. Each row's four views must depict the same source item, not four creative variants. Keep rows aligned and all labels legible. Plain uniform charcoal background. This is enhanced reference artwork, not a native runtime sprite atlas.
Additional source details to preserve: the green skull staff includes tiny detached green magic particles in all four views; keep them small and distinct. The flame staff's west view includes a tiny detached orange spark; retain it. The orb staff is purple, and the skull staff is green.
generation_history.result: All seven rows and 28 occupied views present; some lower-grip gaps joined.

Enhance compact material depth, shaded bevels and clean bright pixel highlights using the same style as page 1. Keep each cell's ORIGINAL pose and partial silhouette. CRITICAL WEST COLUMN REQUIREMENTS:
- magic.rune sword: ONLY its source's short cyan partial blade near upper-left of the cell, plus the tiny detached dark grip fragment at the lower-right. Do not join the fragment to the blade or draw a complete sword.
- magic.flame sword: ONLY its short orange partial blade near upper-left, plus a tiny distant dark grip dot lower-right. Do not invent the missing middle.
- magic.frost axe: preserve the source's compact icy axe head in the west cell; do not invent a long connecting handle.
- magic.storm spear: ONLY the source's small pale spearhead near the top and tiny separated brown shaft remnant near the bottom. Keep the long empty gap; NO continuous pole in this west cell.
- magic.void blade: ONLY the short violet blade fragment near upper-left, plus its tiny distant dark grip dot lower-right. No full dagger.
- magic.holy mace: preserve the west view's golden head-only/short-neck silhouette; no long handle.
In the holy mace S, N and E cells, retain the source's small detached grip segments; don't erase them or force a continuous handle.

All 24 cells remain occupied, but partial cells have substantial empty charcoal space exactly because the source is occluded. Do not complete or beautify these missing parts. The first three columns retain their corresponding original views and proportions. No characters, hands, borders, photorealism, blur, halos, gradients, extra labels, or decorative runes. Crisp polished pixel-art edges, dark contours, consistent top-left highlights. All text legible and spelled exactly. This is reference art, not a native registered sprite atlas.
generation_history.result: All six rows and 24 occupied views present; west partials and detached dots retained, but some S/N/E lower-grip gaps joined.
